name: Compliments
description: Say the thing you've been meaning to say.

cards.text: Tell the person to your left one thing you genuinely admire about them.
Pick someone in the group and describe a quality they have that you wish you had more of.
Tell someone here about a moment they made you feel welcome or included.
Give the group a genuine compliment that has nothing to do with appearance.
Describe someone in the group as if you were writing the opening line of their biography.
Give someone here a compliment about their energy in a room.
Tell someone what their best quality is in exactly three words.
Tell someone in the group about a time they inspired you, even in a small way.
Describe the most unique thing about someone here that you have noticed.
Give someone here a compliment you've been meaning to give them for a while.
Tell someone they are better at something than they give themselves credit for.
Describe what kind of friend you think someone in this group is.
Tell someone here what skill of theirs you would want to borrow for a week.
Tell someone in the group what kind of energy they bring into a room.
Say something to someone here that you think they need to hear right now.
Give someone a compliment that would make their parents proud to hear it.
Tell someone what you think their superpower is.
Compliment someone on their taste — in music, film, food, or style.
Tell someone they have a quality that makes the people around them better.
Describe someone here as a type of weather that matches their personality.
Tell someone what you think their most underrated quality is.
Give someone in the group a compliment as if you were writing a reference letter for them.
Tell someone here what kind of conversation partner they are.
Tell someone what you think their best decision in the last year has been.
Tell someone here what makes them fun to be around.
Give someone the compliment you would want to receive most right now.
